name: blip-2-vision-language
description: Explains how to use Salesforce BLIP-2 (Q-Former bridging a frozen image encoder and an LLM such as OPT or FlanT5) through HuggingFace Transformers and LAVIS for image captioning, visual question answering, image-text matching, and feature extraction.
